chunks: And from him, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Saif ibn 'Amirah, from Abu Bakr, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him), who said:
"When the time for an obligatory prayer enters, do not perform a voluntary prayer."
ai.seo_question: When should one perform voluntary prayers in relation to obligatory prayers?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* establishes the principle of prioritizing the obligatory prayer (fard) over voluntary acts (nafl) once its specific time has commenced, preventing distraction or delay. In Shia jurisprudence, this ruling underscores the sanctity of the fard prayer as the primary duty, ensuring that the believer’s focus remains undivided during the prescribed window for worship.
